瑞士精選旅遊目的地

清晰的鐵路交通指南、實用的每日行程建議、住宿區域分析，以及涵蓋瑞士全境 2,113 個城市與行政區的完整資料庫。

Canton of Zurich · 2–3 days

Zurich (Zürich)

Riverside Old Town guild houses, Lake Zurich swim clubs, world-class art museums and alpine day-trip rail hub.

Canton of Lucerne · 2–3 days

Lucerne (Luzern)

Timber Chapel Bridge, frescoed Old Town squares, Lake Lucerne paddle steamers and Mount Pilatus & Rigi.

Canton of Bern · 3–5 days

Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region (Berner Oberland)

Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau peaks, Lauterbrunnen's 72 waterfalls, Wengen, Mürren and Lake Thun & Brienz.

Canton of Valais · 2–4 days

Zermatt & The Matterhorn (Zermatt)

Car-free alpine village beneath the iconic Matterhorn pyramid, Gornergrat cogwheel railway and glacier trails.

Canton of Bern · 1–2 days

Bern (Bern)

UNESCO sandstone arcades, medieval Zytglogge astronomical clock, Rose Garden views and Aare river swims.

Canton of Geneva · 2 days

Geneva (Genève)

Jet d'Eau fountain, UN district, CERN Science Gateway, Vieille Ville and Lake Geneva cruises.

Canton of Vaud · 2–3 days

Lausanne, Montreux & Lavaux (Riviera Vaudoise)

Château de Chillon, UNESCO terraced Lavaux vineyards, Olympic Museum and GoldenPass Express.

Canton of Graubünden · 2–4 days

St. Moritz & Engadin Valley (St. Moritz)

High-alpine lakes, Bernina & Glacier Express UNESCO rail lines, sgraffito villages and sunny trails.

Canton of Ticino · 2–3 days

Lugano, Locarno & Ticino (Lugano)

Mediterranean palm-lined lakes, Bellinzona UNESCO castles, emerald Verzasca valleys and grotto dining.

Canton of Basel-Stadt · 1–2 days

Basel (Basel)

Switzerland's cultural capital on the Rhine: Fondation Beyeler, Kunstmuseum, red sandstone Minster and Rhine ferries.
